step2_L4_G3.algorithm: Greedy nearest-translate reduction: maintain accumulated h in Delta; at each step, among the 6 neighbor moves {delta_0^+-1, delta_1^+-1, delta_inf^+-1}, accept the one that most decreases hyperbolic distance from the candidate point to a fixed interior basepoint w0 (arithmetic mean of the kite's 4 vertices, a heuristic center, NOT a rigorous Dirichlet-domain center). Stop at a local minimum (no further improving move) or a 60-iteration cap.
step2_L4_G3.acknowledged_limitation: This is a Dirichlet-style nearest-translate reduction, not a literal geodesic-side-of-kite-edge test as spec sec2 L4 describes ('反復的な最近傍アルゴリズム'). It is a legitimate variant of the same family, but its correctness relative to the EXACT kite V (rather than the w0-based Dirichlet cell, which need not coincide with V exactly) has not been independently proven here -- only empirically gated below.

G3_f_termination.detail: all 5 sample points converged within the 60-iteration cap (2-7 iterations actually used)

G3_b_containment.IMPORTANT_CAVEAT: This is EXPLICITLY NOT the spec's exact point-in-kite inclusion test (geodesic side-of-edge tests against the 4 bounding geodesics of V). It only checks that the reduced point's hyperbolic distance to w0 is within 1.05x the maximum vertex-to-w0 distance (a circumradius bound with slack). A point outside V could still pass this proxy. All 5 sample points passed the proxy. Reported honestly as a weaker substitute, not a genuine G3-b PASS.

This is a mathematical argument for why G3-d SHOULD hold, not an independent machine check of it -- flagged explicitly as not meeting this workshop's machine-verification bar.

G3_e_area.plausibility_argument_only: Area additivity under finite-index covering (area(H/Gamma) = [Delta:Gamma]*area(H/Delta)) is a general fact of hyperbolic covering-space theory, independent of any torsion/orbifold subtlety, and the BFS already confirmed all 9 cosets are distinct and fully enumerated (ben1's L3). This argues FOR the total-area value being correct given a valid tiling, but does NOT independently machine-verify that the 9 copies g_i*V actually tile without gaps or overlaps -- that would require e.g. numerical integration or an explicit overlap/gap check, neither implemented this ben.
